author: raymond91125
body:
Dear all, 

The proposal has been made to obsolete
GO:0009255 Entner-Doudoroff pathway through 6-phosphogluconate
GO:0061679 Entner-Doudoroff pathway through gluconate
GO:0061680 Entner-Doudoroff pathway through gluconate to D-glyceraldehyde
GO:0061681 Entner-Doudoroff pathway through gluconate to D-glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate
see https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/31916
Annotations may be moved to GO:0061678 Entner-Doudoroff pathway

Experimental annotations that need to be reviewed are here: 
https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1_5Ub05JvUxVL9FETx9Q_wACb2eBGsfNFDCRXngl1veY/edit?gid=0#gid=0

Impacted groups: 
1 EcoCyc
3 UniProt

** Group contacts: https://github.com/geneontology/go-site/blob/master/metadata/group-contacts.csv
----

Mappings that need to be reviewed: (InterPro2GO, UniProt-Keywords, UniRule) 
GO:0009255	metacyc2go	MetaCyc:PWY-8004 > GO:Entner-Doudoroff pathway through 6-phosphogluconate ; GO:0009255
GO:0009255	interpro2go	InterPro:IPR004786 6-phosphogluconate dehydratase > GO:Entner-Doudoroff pathway through 6-phosphogluconate ; GO:0009255
GO:0009255	hamap2go	HAMAP:MF_02094 > GO:Entner-Doudoroff pathway through 6-phosphogluconate ; GO:0009255
GO:0009255	unirule2go	UniRule:UR000683091 > GO:Entner-Doudoroff pathway through 6-phosphogluconate ; GO:0009255
GO:0009255	unirule2go	UniRule:UR001995752 > GO:Entner-Doudoroff pathway through 6-phosphogluconate ; GO:0009255
GO:0061680	metacyc2go	MetaCyc:NPGLUCAT-PWY > GO:Entner-Doudoroff pathway through gluconate to D-glyceraldehyde ; GO:0061680
GO:0061681	metacyc2go	MetaCyc:PWY-2221 > GO:Entner-Doudoroff pathway through gluconate to D-glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate ; GO:0061681



Thanks.
